correctness.rationale: For precisely one isolated four-switch transverse periodic orbit, section speed signs imply all b_j nonzero with common sign and b_C D,b_C E>0. Outer quadratic-Hamiltonian conservation gives exact reflection maps. Central conservation gives AD=BE and K+(b_C/2)(D^2-E^2)=0. If A=B (including zero), local transversality continuation yields infinitely many genuine periodic cycles, hence isolation forces A!=B and A/B>0. The transverse return derivative is a product of two central normal-speed ratios (outer factors -1 cancel). The signed factorization of mu-1 and strict crossing inequalities show mu>0 and sign(mu-1)=-sign(A-B), excluding mu=1. Exact rational checks cover all six published examples and a numerical four-flight finite-difference check verifies an independent example; neither is used to prove the all-parameter statement.

value.rationale: A count of at most one planar crossing limit cycle cannot determine its attractor or repeller nature, nor rule out a neutral isolated orbit. The present result proves exact strict hyperbolicity and gives a coefficient-only stability test for all six centre/saddle combinations of the established three-zone Hamiltonian problem, including distinct Floquet behavior under time reversal. It predicts the dynamical stability of previously known explicit cycles and supplies an exact multiplier without solving flight times. This addresses an intrinsic missing qualitative invariant of a motivated class rather than a cosmetic parameter substitution.
